about: Named bundles of extensions and skills. Skills use <source>/<skill> ids from the project's .agate/library.json (agate = this hub, anthropic = anthropics/skills). The base library also defines the generic packs documents, design, writing and build; packs here can reference them with pack:<name>.

product.description: Product work: discovery, proposals, data memos, tickets, design system, editorial PDFs.
